title: One Membership Record per Customer Profile
content:
**Rule.** A customer profile may hold only one membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships at a time — one Northgate Rewards or Northgate+ membership, the maximum per customer being 1. Enrollment is accepted only when the customer has no other membership record in enrolled, trial, active, payment hold or cancel pending status. A canceled membership does not count, and a customer may re-enroll after it closes. Moving between tiers is a plan change on the existing record, never a second enrollment. Household members and Business employee seats share the holder's benefits and never hold their own record.

**Basis of judgement.** The test reads the company's own membership records for the customer profile that is enrolling, as they stand before the enrollment is accepted; it is a test of system records, matched to that customer profile.

| Status of the customer's other membership record | Counts against a new enrollment |
|---|---|
| enrolled | yes |
| trial | yes |
| active | yes |
| payment hold | yes |
| cancel pending | yes |
| canceled | no |

**Points of judgement**

- *A customer whose earlier Northgate+ Monthly membership is canceled asks to enroll again.* The canceled record does not count, so the enrollment may be accepted.
- *A customer with an active Northgate Rewards membership wants Northgate+ Annual.* The move is a plan change on the existing record, not a second enrollment.
- *A household member of a Northgate+ Annual holder.* The household member shares the holder's benefits and holds no record of their own.
